WHEREAS
The parties wish to set out the terms of their cooperation.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS
ARTICLE 1. Purpose
This agreement governs the supply of consulting services.
ARTICLE 2. Definitions
Service means any activity agreed between the parties.
PARAGRAPH ONE
The definitions also apply to the annexes.

TITLE II OBLIGATIONS
CLAUSE FIRST. Contractor duties
The contractor shall deliver reports on schedule.
CLAUSE SECOND. Client duties
The client shall pay fees when due.
PARAGRAPH 1
Late payment accrues interest.
